caption: The drawing depicts two views of a single dress design: a detailed view from the back and a lightly sketched outline of the same garment from the side. The main dress is full-length and pale cream in color, with a light green overlay forming a train that pools on the ground. The gown has short, puffed sleeves and a high waist, typical of the early 19th century Regency style. The dress is adorned with a repetitive leafy or vine-like embroidery pattern in a dark, possibly gray or blue color, which decorates the outer edges, hem, and a central vertical panel running the length of the back. The overlay and sleeves also feature similar decorative patterns. The lightly sketched dress to the left shows the side profile and the length of the trailing fabric. The artist's signature, "MELITA HOFMANN," appears in the lower right corner. The composition is centered on the back view of the garment, with neutral, unadorned background to highlight the dress.
title: Court Dress
